golden_seed_alloy.routing_destination: Salt/nail/rail to verse; satin-wake transformation to late return; tired shaker and power-pop seam to production; wave measurements and photo history to sidecar.

triple_arch_ritual_paragraph: Ordinary: her chipped ruby nail holds a ferry rail, repair counter, or wet door handle. Specific: salt dries at the collarbone while one sleeve keeps darkening with spray. Impossible: the wake behind the chosen pair folds shut like a satin seam, bright enough to touch but impossible to keep. Human trace: nail, collarbone, hand, and the other adult's chosen distance remain foreground. Micro-textures: salt crystal, wet cloth, rail vibration, shaker grain, dry handclap. Sonic light/shadow: bass return is the tide; dub pocket is shadow; power-pop chorus is direct flash. Afterimage: she leaves with residue, not regret.

slot_rationale: P06-A won because its title, residue system, and mutual present-tense choice make impermanence joyous across all four rooms; P06-B's last-ferry split was elegant but pushed departure closer to regret and shared a single terminal setting. Panel-forced revision: the addressee is no longer a lesson target—both adults stop bargaining for tomorrow together.
